items.title: House & HYROX at Fitness Quest 10
items.description: Friday night hybrid fitness event at Fitness Quest 10 Pacific Beach — a HYROX-style workout circuit set to a house music DJ set. High intensity, social, and loud. Bring water; the energy matches the playlist.

items.title: Pacific Beach Yoga — Wednesday
items.description: Wednesday morning yoga with Kyle Lyman at 4960 Ocean Blvd. A block from the beach, which is the whole point. Outdoor when weather permits. Consistent instructor, consistent schedule — a good weekly anchor if you're in Pacific Beach mid-week.

items.title: Foodies + New Friends — PB
items.description: Friday night dining social from ADDVentures at a different Pacific Beach restaurant each week. Ticket covers entry; food and drinks are your own tab. Centered around meeting people rather than a fixed menu. Good for solo diners or anyone looking to expand their circle without a bar setting.

items.title: Yoga at Kate Sessions Park
items.description: Saturday morning outdoor yoga with Corie at Kate Sessions Memorial Park. The park sits above Pacific Beach with a bay view and a consistent sea breeze. Bring your own mat; starts promptly at 9. One of the better low-cost outdoor fitness options in PB.

items.title: IPAs by the Beach at JRDN
items.description: Tuesday afternoon IPA social at JRDN on the ground floor of Tower23. Hosted by Adrian and Marena Quijano — specifically focused on IPAs, not a general happy hour. A casual way to try what local and regional brewers are pouring without a set agenda.

items.title: Collective Comedy — Wednesday Night
items.description: Wednesday standup at The Collective on Garnet, hosted by sd_dad_jokes. Rotating lineup of local and visiting comics at 7pm. Smaller and looser than a dedicated comedy club — closer to the comics, more room for crowd interaction.

items.title: Pocket Change at The Collective
items.description: Thursday night residency from Pocket Change at The Collective on Garnet Ave. Live music in a bar format. Note: Open Mic Night (also Thu 7pm at this address) may run on alternating Thursdays — confirm the current schedule on The Collective's social before going.

items.title: 21+ Chess & Board Games at bar Ella
items.description: Thursday chess and board game night at bar Ella Pacific Beach, hosted by San Diego Chess & Social. Casual 21+ format — play or watch. Boards provided; drinks from the bar. Runs at 6:30 consistently, good low-key Thursday option in PB.

items.title: Shoreline Business Connections
items.description: Wednesday morning B2B networking with TEAM Referral Network at San Diego Holistic Wellness in Pacific Beach. Structured referral format — members pitch their businesses and exchange leads. Better suited to established small business owners than casual attendees.

items.title: Taps & Wings at SD TapRoom
items.description: $5 tap beers and $5 wings all night every Tuesday at SD TapRoom in Pacific Beach. No frills — just a sports bar running one of the better standing weekly deals in the neighborhood.

items.title: Christ Center Bonfires at Crown Point
items.description: Sunday evening community bonfires on Crown Point Drive, hosted by Karen Rangel for the Christ Center. Testimonies, worship, potluck, and open fellowship around the fire pit on Mission Bay. Bring something for the potluck if you're coming.
items.address: 3700 Crown Point Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Open Mic Night at The Collective
items.description: Thursday open mic at The Collective on Garnet, hosted by Millertime Music. Sign up on the night; performers get a few songs. May alternate Thursdays with the Pocket Change residency — confirm the current week's format on their Eventbrite or social.

items.title: Trivia at The Duck Dive
items.description: Wednesday night trivia at The Duck Dive — one of PB's most consistent weekly events. 8pm start, team format, general knowledge. The Duck Dive runs special themed editions occasionally; check their Instagram for announcements. Shows up in the neighborhood calendar every week regardless.

items.title: Trivia Night at The Collective
items.description: Tuesday trivia at The Collective on Garnet, hosted by Millertime Music. Different venue and format from the Duck Dive version — check their Eventbrite for team size limits and whether there's a cover.

items.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series — St. Supéry Estate
items.description: JRDN at Tower23 hosts St. Supéry Estate Vineyards & Winery for the Wednesday evening wine series. St. Supéry is a certified organic and sustainable Napa Valley producer. Guided tasting format with Mission Bay as the backdrop. Reservations required — check their Eventbrite for ticket price and availability.

items.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series — Austin Hope
items.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with Austin Hope of Hope Family Wines, Paso Robles. Austin Hope is one of the more recognized names in California red blends and Rhône-style varietals. Guided tasting on the Tower23 ground floor with Mission Bay views. Reservations required.

items.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series — Darren Delmore & Tablas Creek
items.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with Darren Delmore Wines and Tablas Creek. Tablas Creek is the Central Coast benchmark for Rhône producers; Darren Delmore's work there informs his own label. A solid double-bill for anyone interested in Paso Robles Rhône varieties.

items.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series — Curated Selections
items.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series with a curated selection from Vineyard Brands. The importer/distributor format covers multiple wineries in one evening rather than a single producer focus — broader sweep, less depth per label. Good if variety is the priority.

items.title: JRDN Summer Wine Series — Staff Picks Finale
items.description: JRDN Summer Wine Series finale: the Tower23 wine team selects what they've been pouring all summer. The most informal session of the run — no winery representative, just the staff talking through what they liked. Good close to the series.

items.title: Reiki Level 2: Practitioner Training
items.description: Full-day Reiki Level 2 practitioner certification training with Smiling Buddha Bodywork at 4501 Mission Bay Dr. Covers distance healing techniques and the three Level 2 symbols. Requires prior Level 1 certification. Pre-registration required.
items.address: 4501 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 2D, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Mission Bay High Reunion — Class of '81
items.description: Class of 1981 reunion for Mission Bay High School, open to classes of '80, '82, and '83. Hosted at the SD Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club on the water. Ticket required — check the Eventbrite for details on who organized it.
items.locationName: SD Mission Bay Boat & Ski Club
items.address: 1215 El Carmel Pl, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Breakaway + Revel Fit Club Run
items.description: Saturday morning run with Breakaway Run Club finishing at Revel Fit Club at MARA. Social run format — designed for people who want the run club experience without a competitive edge. Check their Eventbrite for the exact route and whether gear is needed.
items.address: 4275 Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Industry Night at Studio Golf
items.description: Saturday evening simulator golf event for hospitality and food & beverage industry workers. Discounted rates for industry staff. Social format — not a competitive round. Confirm the current Studio Golf San Diego address before going; the venue may have moved.
items.address: 4275 Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Birth and Beyond Meet Up — Kate Sessions
items.description: Outdoor meet-up for new and expecting parents at Kate Sessions Memorial Park, hosted by doula Arri Towner. The park gives kids space to move and parents a place to sit and compare notes. The 'Southern Location' tag suggests there's a parallel northern meet-up running the same series.

items.title: HYROX Full Simulation at Fitness Quest 10
items.description: Full HYROX race simulation at Fitness Quest 10 Pacific Beach — eight functional fitness stations with the running segments between them. A complete rehearsal of the official race format. Entry via Eventbrite; spaces are capped. 8am start.

items.title: Women's Learn to Play Chess — Tavern at the Beach
items.description: 21+ women's chess class and social at Tavern at the Beach, hosted by San Diego Chess & Social. Beginner-friendly — no experience needed. Runs about 90 minutes with bar service throughout. A daytime social that doesn't require knowing how to play.

items.title: Harry Potter Twisted Trivia at The Collective
items.description: Harry Potter themed trivia night at The Collective on Garnet, produced by SDHosted. The 'twisted' format adds curveball questions and audience challenges beyond straight recall. The Collective programs themed trivia nights on top of their weekly schedule.

items.title: Pickleball at Pacific Beach Tennis Club
items.description: Tuesday evening pickleball at Pacific Beach Tennis Club, organized by Isabell Faulds. Social rather than competitive — pickup game format. Check the Eventbrite for current pricing and whether paddles are provided.

items.title: Girl Dinner Tour — Tinis and Weenies @ bar Ella
items.description: See You in SD's Girl Dinner Tour at bar Ella Pacific Beach: the 'Tinis and Weenies' edition. The tour format is a social dining experience moving through a few cocktail-and-bites stops. Check their Eventbrite for the current itinerary and ticket price.

items.title: Star Wars Trivia at SD TapRoom
items.description: Star Wars themed trivia night at SD TapRoom PB. A one-off theme layered over their regular events calendar. Runs the same night as Duck Dive trivia a few blocks over — different venue, same time block, pick your allegiance.

items.title: Baby Brain Building Workshop
items.description: Baby brain development workshop with Dr. Stephanie Libs, DC at Cafe of Life Chiropractic in Pacific Beach. Covers infant neurological development and hands-on activities parents can use at home. Small group, morning format.

items.title: Wu Xing Reiki — Five Element Session
items.description: Five Element Reiki session with Smiling Buddha Bodywork at 4501 Mission Bay Dr. The Wu Xing framework maps energy to seasons, organs, and emotional states — a different orientation than standard Usui Reiki. Drop-in with pre-registration; afternoon session at 3:30.
items.address: 4501 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 2D, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Psychedelic Breathwork — Ritual Wellness
items.description: Guided psychedelic breathwork session with Ritual Wellness Collective at 3510 Ingraham St. Uses holotropic-style breathing to produce altered states without substances. Eye mask, music, facilitated integration session afterward. Pre-registration required; spaces are limited.

items.title: Glam Slam Tennis Social
items.description: Recreational tennis social from Coastal Court Society at Pacific Beach Tennis Club. The Glam Slam format is about social play and connecting with other recreational players — not a tournament. Bring your racket; court fees may apply.

items.title: Mabon Gathering — Autumn Equinox
items.description: Autumn equinox (Mabon) gathering at Smiling Buddha Bodywork. Seasonal ritual marking the second harvest — typically includes meditation, grounding exercises, and seasonal reflection. Small group, registration required.
items.address: 4501 Mission Bay Dr, Suite 2D, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Margaritas & Mingle — Founders Networking
items.description: Founders and entrepreneurs networking happy hour at Hideaway Pacific Beach, hosted by Brandon Fortino. Informal format — no presentations, no pitches, just drinks and conversation between people building things. Free to attend; drinks are your own tab.

items.title: Kinky Speed Dating Mixer — PB
items.description: 21+ alternative speed dating mixer hosted by Kinky Dating Mixers at bar Ella Pacific Beach. Standard speed dating format with an explicit kink-friendly framing. Ticket required — check their Eventbrite for current pricing and the RSVP cap.

items.title: Escape to Relaxation — Mini Retreat
items.description: Afternoon mini retreat for grounding and self-compassion, facilitated by Marni Goldberg (LMFT LPCC) and Samantha Conboy at Mindful Matters Counseling in Pacific Beach. A structured afternoon of guided practice — not a therapy session. Small group format.

items.title: Vampire Diaries Trivia at The Duck Dive
items.description: Special themed trivia night at The Duck Dive: Vampire Diaries edition. A one-off theme layered over their Wednesday 8pm trivia format. The Duck Dive runs these a few times a year; standard team rules apply.

items.title: Fall 2026 Group Coaching — Kate Sessions
items.description: Outdoor group coaching session at Kate Sessions Memorial Park with Better in Company. The outdoor setting is intentional — coaching in a park rather than an office or Zoom call. Small cohort format; register on Eventbrite before attending.

items.title: Sunday Ritual — Ritual Wellness Collective
items.description: Sunday morning wellness gathering from Ritual Wellness Collective at 3510 Ingraham St. Format varies by week — could be a breathwork session, sound bath, or guided meditation. Check their current Eventbrite listing for the specific format before going.

items.title: Oktoberfest at PB Shore Club
items.description: Oktoberfest afternoon at the PB Shore Club's beer garden. Organized by Ask Ros, She Travels — German beer selections, seasonal food, and a social setup on the waterfront. More of a drinking social than a traditional Oktoberfest festival, but the ocean view makes up for it.

items.title: Girl Dinner Tour — bar Ella PB
items.description: See You in SD's Girl Dinner Tour returns to bar Ella Pacific Beach. 'Girl Dinner' edition — cocktails and bites across a few stops. Check their Eventbrite for the current itinerary and ticket price.

items.title: A Comedy Show at PorchLight Coffee
items.description: Stand-up comedy show at PorchLight Coffee from Banana Peel Productions. Small venue format — closer to a house show than a comedy club. Banana Peel runs these at rotating PB and beach-area spots. Check their Eventbrite for ticket price and door policy.

items.title: Screen Your Teen — Free Cardiac Screening
items.description: Free cardiac screening event for teenagers at Mission Bay High School, organized by the Eric Paredes Save A Life Foundation. Screens for hidden heart conditions that can go undetected until a cardiac event. No appointment needed; bring a parent or guardian.

items.title: Harry Potter Trivia at The Duck Dive
items.description: Harry Potter themed trivia night at The Duck Dive. One of their most-attended themed editions — more specific than the general Wednesday format. Standard team size and bar rules. Arrive a few minutes early; tables fill fast on theme nights.

items.title: Friends Trivia at The Duck Dive
items.description: Friends TV series themed trivia night at The Duck Dive. One of the most-attended themed nights in their annual calendar. Wednesday 8pm slot — same as their regular trivia, just Friends-specific questions all night.

items.title: PB Tuesday Farmers' Market
items.description: The neighborhood's weekly certified farmers market, running rain or shine on Bayard and Hornblend. Produce, meat, cheese, eggs, bread, flowers, prepared food and craft vendors across two blocks. EBT accepted — the information booth converts benefits into market credit and there's a match program that adds free produce on top. Live music most weeks. HOURS: majority of sources say 2-7pm; the market's own website says 2-6pm. Confirm with the market manager at 858-273-3303.

items.title: HeArt of Pacific Beach Restaurant Walk
items.description: Annual restaurant walk down Garnet Avenue run by Discover Pacific Beach, pairing tastings from participating restaurants with work from local artists. Runs the eastern stretch of Garnet from Dawes to Lamont. Ticketed in advance, roughly $35-40.
items.locationName: Garnet Ave (Dawes St to Lamont St)
items.address: Garnet Ave & Lamont St, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Pacific Beachfest
items.description: The neighborhood's largest annual event — a free family festival along the boardwalk with live music, local vendors, a kids zone, and community activities. Runs 9am-7pm. The Pacific Beach 5K runs on the sand and boardwalk as part of the same day.
items.address: Ocean Front Walk & Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Pacific Beach 5K
items.description: The 5K half of the Pacific Beach race weekend, run as part of Beachfest. The course is roughly half sand and half boardwalk, starting and finishing on the beach — an unusual surface mix that makes it slower than a road 5K. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE — confirm with San Diego Running Co before the event.
items.address: Ocean Front Walk & Garnet Ave, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Pacific Beach Half Marathon
items.description: Point-to-point half marathon starting at Crown Point Park in Mission Bay and finishing on the sand where Thomas Ave meets the boardwalk. The course runs the waterfront past SeaWorld, Hospitality Point, the West Mission Bay Drive bridge and Mission Beach. Race two of a three-race San Diego series. START TIME IS AN ESTIMATE — confirm with San Diego Running Co before the event.
items.address: 3700 Crown Point Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

items.title: Pacific Beach Town Council General Meeting
items.description: Monthly general meeting of the Pacific Beach Town Council, open to the whole neighborhood. The Town Council covers local issues and runs community programming including the summer concert series. Third Wednesday of every month. VENUE UNCONFIRMED — check pbtowncouncil.org for the current meeting location before pinning.
